headline: Australia Regulator Issues Warning to Santos Over Barossa Gas Project
summary: Australia's national regulator issued a warning to Santos, the country's second-largest oil and gas company, following inspections of its multi-billion-dollar Barossa project.
why: Santos is a major Australian energy producer, and regulatory warnings on large-scale offshore projects can introduce compliance costs or operational delays.

impacts.name: Santos Ltd
impacts.why: Regulatory scrutiny and compliance warnings create potential project execution risks.
